text: I have been locked out of my account for two weeks. Every password reset locks it again. My paycheque is in there and I can't buy groceries. I've called five times. Aayush Stone
The password reset email never arrives. I checked spam. My email is customer45967@example.net.
I am trying to open a chequing account. The branch has asked me to bring my documents three separate times and each time someone says something else is missing. I have been trying for a month.
I changed my phone number and now the two step verification codes go to my old number so I can't sign in. I updated it at the branch but it still isn't working. New number is (902) 555-0122.

My father passed away in March and I am the executor of his estate. I have sent the death certificate and the will twice and I still cannot access his account to pay the funeral home. Every call I have to explain it all again. John Harrison

I disputed a $280 purchase six weeks ago because the furniture was never delivered. The merchant won't answer and your dispute team keeps saying it is 'in progress'. I paid for something I never got. Card 6011-1111-1111-1117.

I am travelling in Portugal and you blocked my credit card for 'suspicious activity' even though I told you about the trip. I have no other card, I can't pay for my hotel tonight and I'm stuck. Please unblock it. Ijaya Butala, 604-555-0144
Hello, the ATM at the mall kept my card this afternoon. Could you please let me know how I get it back or order a new one? Thank you.
My new card came in the mail but the PIN letter never did. Can you send it again?
Your ATM swallowed my card last Friday and then you charged me a $25 replacement fee for it. That's your machine's fault, not mine. I want a free replacement and the fee reversed. Marc Dubois
The website takes forever to load my e-statements, sometimes a minute or more. It works in the end but it's frustrating.
Since the last update the mobile app crashes every time I open it. I can't check my balance or pay bills. I've reinstalled it twice.
The app showed my balance as zero yesterday and I panicked. Today it shows the right amount. What happened? Is my money safe?
app login screen just spins and spins
I get the same push notification about a promotion five times a day and I can't find where to turn it off.
I paid my full credit card balance before the due date but I was still charged $37 interest. I have the confirmation. Please explain and refund.
I noticed a $3.12 foreign transaction fee on a purchase. I don't remember being told about this fee. Can you explain where it is in my agreement?

This is the third month in a row your fees have pushed me into overdraft and then you charge me more fees for being overdrawn. If this isn't fixed I am filing a complaint with the banking ombudsman. Pratyush Guay
Why was I charged $3 for using one of your own ATMs? It was a Maple Harbour Bank machine.
FEES FEES FEES. MONTHLY FEE, E-TRANSFER FEE, PAPER STATEMENT FEE. I HAVE BEEN WITH YOU FOR 20 YEARS AND I AM SICK OF IT. I WANT THEM ALL REFUNDED OR I AM MOVING MY ACCOUNTS.

This morning I found two e-transfers of $600 each that I never sent, both to someone I have never heard of. I changed my password straight away. My name is Kerry Lachapelle and I want the $1,200 returned.
theres a 9.99 charge from some streaming service on my card every month since june and i never signed up for it. i dont even know what it is

My father is 84 and lives alone. A man who says he is a bank investigator keeps calling him and has convinced him to withdraw cash three times this week, $2,000 each time. He is going to do it again tomorrow. His account number is 00529-3031399. I am his daughter, Clive Morgan, reachable at c.morgan21@example.org.
unauthorized atm withdrawal $500 yesterday 11pm. wasnt me. card was in my wallet.

My phone suddenly lost service and when I got it back someone had logged into my online banking, changed my email and phone number, and is moving money out. I can't log in to stop it. This is Susan Dumont, please freeze everything now. My other number is (604) 555-0121.

I lost my job in August and I can't make my mortgage payment. I don't know how I'm going to feed my kids. I can't sleep and honestly I don't see the point of anything anymore. Please, is there anything you can do. Jerry Labonté
My mortgage payment of $1,850 was taken twice this month. That left me short for everything else. I want the duplicate returned today. Mortgage number 76427-7705211.
I applied for a car loan six weeks ago and I still have no decision. The dealer will not hold the car much longer. Every time I call I am told it is with underwriting.
My mortgage renewal letter arrived after the renewal date so I was put on a higher rate automatically. I would have chosen a different term if I had received it on time.

I received a letter saying you will start foreclosure on my home at 464 Amanda Crossroad, Lake Stephen, PE J6T6C7 for missed payments. I have not missed a single payment and I have the bank statements to prove it. I have given everything to my lawyer and we will take legal action if this is not withdrawn this week.
BEST PRICES on luxury watches!!! Visit our store today for 70% off, limited time only, click the link in our profile.
What are your branch hours over the holiday weekend?
the thing with the stuff from before is happening again, same as last time
My phone company overcharged me again this month and their customer service is useless. Can you believe it?
Hello, I would like to apply for a teller job at your bank. Who should I send my resume to? Nitesh Dodd, (613) 555-0112

I received a bank statement in the mail today that belongs to another customer, Janaki Ford, with his account number and balance on it. If you are sending his to me, who is getting mine? I live at 560 Lewis Springs Apt. 246, Port Monica, SK M3E 8R5.
Someone at your branch told my ex-husband my new address and my account balance when he came in asking about me. We are separated and he is not on my accounts. How could this happen? Jeremy Palla
45 days ago I asked in writing for a copy of all the personal information you hold about me. I've had no response at all. Please treat this as a formal follow-up. Onkar León, o.leon91@example.net
I just got an email from your mortgage team that had about 200 other customers' email addresses visible in the To field. Mine is customer57215@example.net. This is a data breach.
I saw on the news that a company you work with had a data breach. Was my information included? Nobody has told me anything.
I paid my hydro bill through online banking but the money went to a different payee with a similar name. Now hydro says I'm late. How do I get the $142.60 back?
I typed one digit wrong and sent $600 to the wrong account. I called the same day and was told it would be recalled but it's been a week. The account I meant was 89011-3524377.
Hi, my automatic monthly transfer to savings didn't happen this month. Not urgent, just wanted to flag it. Thanks!
I sent money to my mother in India nine days ago and it still hasn't arrived. Your website said 2 to 3 business days. She needs it for her medicine.
My credit card payment of $780 went through twice from my chequing account, which put me into overdraft, and now there's an overdraft fee too. Please reverse the duplicate payment.
I called your contact centre three times today and was disconnected every time after waiting over 30 minutes. This keeps happening. Jeff Reeves, 306 555 0131
The branch on Elm Street was closed at 2pm on a Tuesday even though the sign and your website say it's open until 5.

My mother is 79 and has early dementia. An advisor at your branch sold her a five-year locked investment with her entire savings while I was not there. She does not understand what she signed. I am her daughter Marie Beaulieu.
Three weeks ago a manager promised to call me back within 48 hours about my account. Nobody has called. I've left two more messages.
Your security guard grabbed my arm and pushed me out of the branch because I was 'loitering' while waiting for my wife. I am reporting this to the regulator and I want the footage kept.
